tasks.title: Update README.md
tasks.description:
Update README.md to reflect the TypeScript-only architecture:

- Update installation section to mention bun as a prerequisite and that install.sh runs bun build
- Update file/directory structure to show src/ as the main code, lib/ as Python narration only
- Remove references to shell scripts, bin/ralph, RALPH_FORCE_SHELL
- Update any usage examples if they reference the old shell entry point
- Keep it concise and accurate — read the current README.md first and make targeted updates
tasks.notes: Updated prerequisites (removed Python 3, added Bun), updated installation blurb to mention bun build, replaced shell-scripts-based file structure with TypeScript src/ layout. No other sections referenced bin/ralph or RALPH_FORCE_SHELL.

tasks.title: Full test suite + build verification
tasks.description:
Run the full verification suite to confirm everything works after the shell-to-TS cutover:

1. Run 'bun test' — all tests must pass (expect 601+ tests)
2. Run 'bun run build' — must compile cleanly to dist/ralph
3. Run './dist/ralph --version' — must print version string

If any tests fail, investigate and fix the root cause. Common issues:
- Tests that reference deleted files (ralph_common.sh, fallback.ts)
- Tests that check for RALPH_FORCE_SHELL behavior
- Tests that assert specific command counts including fallback commands
- Import errors from removed modules

Do NOT skip or delete failing tests — fix them or the code they test.
